previousDefectsResolved: Appeal ladder: the case document now rides above each step; 'Facts corrected' stays legible throughout sentence 3 in all themes.
Goals flag pole now stands in the gap between the middle and right heads (verified with a tight zoom in all themes); it no longer pierces or overlays a person.

Citizen expressions follow the plan: scene 1 line 1 shows a raised brow and a small smile (intrigued), line 2 a calm, steady face with a pointing gesture (resolute, no longer angry), line 3 raised inner brows and a downturned mouth (concerned). The scene 3 verdict shows a confident small smile (convinced).
Separate powers are labelled as each icon appears (Set goals / Run infrastructure / Oversee rights).
The controlling actor is now visible: a crowned figure grips the locked ring around the infrastructure chip.
Terminology is consistent ('21 clauses' / '21 draft clauses').
The independent citizen holds both provider lines in their hands, not on the shoulders, and a check mark sits above them.

moderate: Scene 2 sentence 2 (exit, ~0:43-0:47) in Color/Light/Dark: the traveller never holds the suitcase that carries identity, records and services. Both hands hang empty while the case floats beside him about 15-25 stage px above the floor line, and it glides in parallel during the walk to the new provider. The sentence is about these things moving with the person, but hand, prop and floor contact are inconsistent with carrying (ART_DIRECTION: hands, feet and interaction surfaces consistent with the intended action; physical support).

Scene 3 sentence 4 (closing invitation, ~1:35-1:36, about 0.6-1.5 s after the sentence starts) in Color/Light/Dark: the book opens by horizontal squash. It first appears as a thin warped sliver whose page lines become stacked arcs, while the full-size bookmark floats detached in empty space to its right until the book reaches full width (ART_DIRECTION book shapes: avoid warped pages; bookmark belongs to the book).
minor: Brief cross-fade overlap at the start of a sentence (~0.3-0.8 s). In scene 2 sentence 4, the opaque Set goals dome sits over the still-fading appeal ladder and covers 'Reasons' and 'Facts corrected'. In scene 3 sentence 2, the draft document fades in over the clause ring labels.

At 393 px, secondary labels (Identity/Records/Services, Mandate, Who pays?, clause names, appeal steps) render at about 7-8 CSS px, and at 320 px at about 5-6 px. The captions carry the meaning, but the in-art labels are unreadable on the smallest phones.
Dark theme: the pencil beside the social contract loses its dark tip and reads as a plain gold bar.

checkedOk: The visuals match each sentence: governance key handed toward the chip that offers comfort/safety/experiences; social contract with 21 clauses and an editing pencil; locked ring held by an irreplaceable crowned leader; mandate from goals to administration, with the delivered services; exit with identity, records and services carried to the new provider; a four-step appeal ending in a green remedy; three separated powers; protections ringed around a household; who pays / who enforces / why comply; comfortable dependency (tethered, seated) versus reduced dependency (two providers, check); the book open at the Introduction and The political offer.
Character identity is stable in Color, Light and Dark: blue-coat citizen, green-coat bald traveller, ochre-coat seated woman. Limbs stay visible on Dark, with no ghost or duplicated limbs.
Captions show one whole sentence and clear the art at every sampled width. Scene headings are bold and contained, and backgrounds are flat in all themes.
Duration is 1:47, within the two-minute limit.
requiredFixes: Attach the suitcase to the traveller's hand (a carry pose with a hand on the handle) at floor-consistent height, and move them together as one unit or with matched timing.
Open the closing book without a warped squash, or scale and reveal the bookmark with the book so it is never detached.

moderate: Scene 2 'Delegate, never surrender', sentence 3 (appeal ladder, ~0:50-0:52, roughly 10-35% of the sentence) in Color/Light/Dark: the climbing appeal document is drawn over the 'Facts corrected' step label, reducing it to 'Fa / corr' exactly while the narrator says 'corrected facts'; the label only clears once the document moves on to Independent review.

Scene 2 sentence 1 (Goals -> Mandate -> Administration) in all three themes: the flag pole of the 'Goals' group is drawn down into the middle figure's head, so the pole looks stuck through the head for the whole sentence. This is a prop drawn over a person.

Citizen expressions do not match the emotional plan. Scene 1 line 1 (planned 'intrigued', voice 'open warmly') renders the 'curious' face with a downturned mouth and raised inner brows, and it is almost the same as the 'worried' face in line 3, which flattens the curiosity-to-concern arc. The 'determined' face in scene 1 line 2 ('takes that offer seriously', resolute) and in scene 3 line 3 (verdict, 'convinced') shows lowered brows and a hard mouth that reads as anger or hostility in Color/Light/Dark.
minor: Scene 2 sentence 4: the three powers (assembly dome, chip, scales) stay unlabelled until about 70% of the sentence. 'Set goals / Run infrastructure / Oversee rights' appear only after the narrator has named them.

Scene 3 sentence 3 opening (~3% / scene edge): the seated 'comfortable dependency' figure fades in over the still-visible 'Who pays?' coins and the 21-articles diagram, giving a brief ghosted overlap.
Terminology drift: scene 1 shows the document as '21 clauses' but scene 3 shows '21 draft articles' for the same contract.

Scene 3 line 3: the yellow and blue provider lines attach to the independent citizen's shoulders like marionette strings, so 'reduced dependency' could be read as being tied to more providers. The check mark helps, but the metaphor is ambiguous.
Scene 1 line 3: the irreplaceable 'leadership' is shown only as a ringed, locked chip. No controlling actor is visible.

At 393/320 px, the secondary labels (Identity/Records/Services, Who pays?, Mandate, clause icons) render at about 7-8 CSS px and are hard to read. A large empty band sits between the art and the caption.

positives: Identity is stable across themes: blue-coat citizen, green-coat traveller, ochre-coat seated figure.
Captions show one whole sentence and clear the artwork at every width.
The scene headings are strong and contained, and the backgrounds are flat in all three themes.
The Night theme keeps paper ink dark and limbs visible.
The visual verbs fit the claims: provider exit carries identity/records/services, the appeal climbs to a remedy, the powers separate, and the closing book is open at the Introduction.
